title: [main] bug 644148 - Use VAT base amount (after discounts) for reverse charge limit check
summary: Reverse Charge VAT commodity limit check for Czech invoices now evaluates the amount after discounts (VAT base) instead of the gross unit price amount to align with Czech GFR regulation.
key_points: Limit calculation changed from gross unit price × quantity to line amount after discounts
Affects Czech Reverse Charge VAT determination on sales invoices with line or invoice discounts
Invoices where gross exceeds limit but net falls below it now correctly use Normal VAT
Test coverage added for scenarios above and below limit after discount application
Regulatory compliance fix for Czech tax requirements
quote: The decisive amount should be the total VAT base stated on the tax document, i.e. the amount after line discounts and invoice discounts.
